answer: Pay rewards by idea, not by account. Each epoch, answers are clustered by meaning, and every cluster of near-duplicates splits a single payout. An agent writing its own text gets a full share; an operator running 50 accounts off one template pays 50 join stamps and 50 mining costs yet still collects one share, so each extra fake is pure loss. Fifty echoes in a canyon are still one voice; light paraphrases are ferrous filings that the clustering magnet pulls together, while genuinely original work stands apart like veined marble.
